file_impact.reason: Adds the full-route advisory scanner-integration job wired to _scanner-integration.yml with Gerrit patchset inputs, and keeps it out of vote.needs and out of vote normalization so it cannot cast Verified -1.

The scanner reusable's Gerrit entry point; adjusted so the advisory job invoked from gerrit-verify.yaml resolves correctly on a patchset. Omitted from the original plan and added here after the merged commit showed it changed (4 lines).
Asserts gerrit-verify.yaml contains the advisory scanner-integration job using the shared reusable with Gerrit patchset inputs.
Proves the scanner is excluded from vote.needs and from normalization, and that CONCLUSION derives from explicit required-route needs.*.result without env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION.
Inverted assertion proving the scanner workflow is shared by both the mirror and the Gerrit advisory lane rather than duplicated.
Asserts the scanner reusable is reachable from the gerrit-verify.yaml workflow closure, so future patchsets exercise it from main.
